intent: Give release lint the existing debug-lint process budget with current memory admission and retained phase diagnostics, preserving every lint check and the 45-minute outer gate.

failureEvidence.observation: The final release-lint process reported heap pressure at its configured 3 GiB heap and 1 GiB metaspace, then Actions terminated the step after 45 minutes. No release-lint verdict was produced. The preceding isolated release compilation completed successfully in 6m57s; its dependencies were UP-TO-DATE during the final lint invocation.
failureEvidence.qualification: This is not evidence of a thrown Java OutOfMemoryError or an OS kill. The same source tree's PR lint completed despite the same warning. The proposed 4 GiB budget remains a candidate requiring actual exact-source CI. Retained earlier compilation GC logs do not measure the failed lint process.

candidate.headroomDesign: A lint-specific adapter re-evaluates complete known numeric observations from the unchanged production observer against its fixed budget. Unknown or insufficient RAM/cgroup headroom refuses launch.

constraints: Keep both release compatibility and lint tasks, lint rules and baselines, one worker, disabled configuration cache, and the existing outer timeout.
Do not edit application source, dependencies, global Gradle settings, versions, release scope, release notes or generated metadata.
Do not rerun workflows, dispatch, push, merge or publish from this worker.
Use host behavior tests and canonical fast validation; actual release-lint qualification remains hosted.
plannedValidation: Exercise the actual memory parser and adapter at the exact boundary, one byte below it, finite ancestor limits, missing observations and uncounted swap.

Execute the extracted workflow shell with the real admission and retry code, controlling only resource observations and the Gradle child; prove refusal prevents launch and Gradle failure propagates through tee.
Demonstrate the launch-blocking regression against the unchanged baseline workflow as a negative control.
Run the smallest relevant host tests and preserve exact source/result hashes. Root will run canonical fast validation after coordinated version, release-scope and generated-metadata integration.

focusedHostSuite.scope: Eleven new admission/workflow tests, seven existing unit-admission tests and fifteen existing retry/deadline tests; no Android lint execution.

admissionControl.proof: Local admission-control receipt; the committed behavior regressions execute again in canonical and hosted validation.
admissionControl.scope: Exact baseline workflow starts the controlled Gradle child for unknown and insufficient headroom; corrected workflow blocks both. Actual observation/parser/retry code executes, with only host reads and the Gradle child controlled.

validation.productionObserverRetryAndGlobalSettings: Byte-identical to 8abda66c; input hashes recorded in the proof manifest.

hostedReleaseLint.scope: No claim that the candidate 4 GiB budget completes actual release lint.
